scope: GTK4 4.18.6 native gallery hover hints in Xephyr :76 at 1280x800; two visible gallery pages; no theme palette, installed style, or historical pixel comparison
changes: The transparent GtkFixed overlay hosting GtkMenuButton popover anchors no longer accepts pointer input, so native controls beneath it receive events.
Vertical-scrollbar popovers temporarily suppress ancestor tooltips while hovered and restore them immediately on leave, preventing the GtkScrolledWindow hint from appearing at the same time.
The read-only/disabled GtkEntry hint was shortened after the rightmost field's native tooltip exceeded the 1280 px screen edge.

matrix.popover_anchor_cleanup: 2 anchors before close, 0 after; close idempotent; native tooltip state restored

limits: This is a real GTK4 runtime interaction/geometry test, not a comparison against Domain/OS pixels.
The test used GTK's active default palette and did not validate theme colors across schemas.
T07 remains partial: other families, layouts, later-created controls, and manual review are outstanding.
